summary.zh: 接入 Stripe 结账、订阅与退款
summary.en: Integrate Stripe checkout, subscriptions, and refunds

description.zh: 讲解 Stripe Checkout、Payment Intent、订阅与退款的标准接入方式，包含 webhook 验签和 PCI 合规要点，并给出服务端与前端配合的示例。适合在 Web 或移动应用里搭建支付和订阅系统时对照使用。联调需要 Stripe 账号与 API Key，本地测试可用 Stripe CLI 转发事件。
description.en: Covers Stripe Checkout, Payment Intents, subscriptions, and refunds, with webhook signature checks and PCI scope notes. Use it when building payment or subscription flows in a web or mobile app. Testing needs a Stripe account and API keys.
